output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balances of the target address are increased without a check, allowing the total supply to overflow and become very large, devaluing the token.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer a token amount to any target address, including a smart contract that has a fallback function, allowing attackers to steal funds.

output_list.vulnerability: The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When burning, the balances of the target address are decreased without a check, allowing the total supply to overflow and become very large, devaluing the token.

output_list.reason: The changeFree function allows the owner to set a new token amount for non-owner addresses, causing a sudden decrease in token value.
